name: task_demo
notes: LOOKS LIKE: a full reach-and-place through free space — the arm rises to 45, extends the forearm out to -40 with a 20 deg wrist set, lowers onto the spot, closes the jaws, lifts clear, releases and folds back. Still NOT a calibrated pick-and-place: nothing was taught from a demonstration and there is no perception, so it is a plausible motion through free space, not a grasp of anything in particular. Say so on stage — the tier=act decision is real, the arm's repertoire is this one trajectory. Peak 13.3 deg/s. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.
